description: This file defines the main test runner class for Cucumber with JUnit integration. It specifies configuration options for running BDD feature files in parallel, with details about test suite execution, report generation, and scenario selection tags.

classes.name: TestRunner
classes.description: Main class that configures and initiates Cucumber test execution with JUnit. It is annotated with @RunWith and @CucumberOptions to specify features, glue code, report plugins, tags, and execution options.
